note: Catalogue capture for the held tier-2 Kawasaki Ninja250R / GPX250R Motorcycle Service Manual Supplement (Internet Archive scan, 162 pages). It holds the Kawasaki EX250-F (Ninja 250R / GPX250R) as a wheeled motorcycle entry. The General Specifications table (Items EX250-F2 ~ F13) publishes the overall dimensions, wheelbase, road clearance, dry weight, curb weight by axle, the engine type and displacement, the maximum power and torque ratings, the six-speed constant-mesh manual transmission, the chain final drive and the front and rear tyre sizes. The entry is runtime-ready: operating weight resolves from the published curb weight, net power from the published maximum rating and the two tyre fields from the rear tyre size code. The 2006-2007 model supplement (printed page 20-4) prints a 1 410 mm wheelbase for the EX250F6F series; the base table prints 1 400 mm for EX250-F2 to F13, a different model range, so the entry keeps the base figure and names both. No real source maps an AEE game class to the EX250-F, so class_token is empty.
